basis: Generated by tools/build_route_contract_matrix.py from app.openapi() and app.routes of create_app(Config()) (hardware probes of the runtime catalog stubbed), the MCP registry of create_mcp(), the source of each MCP tool/resource and Client method, and the explicit family, CLI and semantics tables in the generator (semantics rows of origin table, derived from the declared request model fields, or shared from the operation whose handler another operation runs); deviation adapters joined from docs/protocol_deviations.json; the required scope of every operation from broker.scopes.ROUTE_SCOPES and the broker surfaces from broker/surfaces.py. The app is built in standalone role under a fresh temporary TITANOS_HOME, so a populated broker.json, keys.json or vault index of the caller cannot change it. Semantics rows describe the local handlers: a request BrokerDispatch routes to a cloud or router target (operations with broker_surfaces) is answered before FastAPI parses it, with the semantics recorded in the broker-* sections of docs/PROTOCOL_DEVIATIONS.md and the cells of docs/BROKER_MATRIX.md. Deterministic: sorted rows and keys, no timestamps; tests/check_route_contract_matrix.py asserts the rebuild is a fixed point and that every semantics citation resolves. References are repository-relative.

Keyless loopback mode: the anonymous loopback principal holds broker.scopes.ANONYMOUS_LOOPBACK_SCOPES (key and credential writes answer 403 keyless_mode_refused), cross-site browser requests are refused 403, and a non-loopback bind with nothing enforced answers 401. registry_gate.not_tracked: public route: never answered by the registry gate
registry_gate.tracked: answers 503 registry_reloading/registry_unavailable while the registry reloads or is unavailable

vocabulary.scope_rules: admin covers every scope; inference covers inference:*; cloud covers cloud:<upstream_id> but not cloud:store; broker:admin covers broker:read; models:write covers models:read; a value a|b is satisfied by either scope; authenticated is satisfied by any principal (never granted); a route missing from ROUTE_SCOPES needs admin (fail closed)

semantics.declared-only: named by a document, capability record, docstring or field, but no code path provides it
semantics.ignored: accepted by the schema or transport but never read on that path (including a client disconnect that no cancellation observes)
semantics.implemented: the control reaches the backend or transport with the documented effect
semantics.rejected: refused explicitly (400/422/409/499 or a schema Literal admitting one value) instead of being approximated
semantics.rejected-in-job: accepted by the schema and answered 202 by a job route, then refused explicitly inside the job thread: the refusal surfaces only as job record status failed with the error string on GET /api/jobs/{identifier} (jobs.py:210, :177); no HTTP status or error code reaches the caller

semantics_origin.derived: emitted for every operation whose JSON request model declares the field (DERIVED_FIELD_SEMANTICS)
semantics_origin.shared: copied from the operation named in shared_from, whose handler this operation runs with the qualifier prefixed to the control (SHARED_SEMANTICS)
semantics_origin.table: an explicit SEMANTICS row of the generator
